note: Campground in the church grove of St. Lorenz Lutheran Church (Frankenmuth), open to the public; grass RV/tent sites. The grove's pavilion, kitchen and craft buildings are rented out, and a half-mile prayer trail loops the grounds. --Claude
summary: Church's own Churchgrove Park page: 2026 season April 27 - October 25 (was opens 05-01), $40 a night and $45 for 50 amp (fees added; electric 30 -> 50), no reservations, first come first served (confirmed). Phone 989-652-6141 matches. Public camping: the page posts nightly fees with no membership or retreat restriction and says nothing of closing for church events. Google Maps: open, 4.7 stars / 155 reviews. Not stated on the page: site count, water at sites, showers, dump (derived values left). No gateway within 40 km; the family has not stayed here; base $40 under the gate. Note cleaned of the site/hookup/price/season/booking text the fields hold.
